notes.title: STUFFED: Content Update #2
notes.notes:
Content Update #2
Build 0.11.0

In Depth Description: https://bit.ly/StuffedBlogPost2

Updates 

 Added third person attack animations to Player Character 
 Added Ultimate Power ups – Real Bear and Chest Burst 
 New culling system - This will save on rendering performance and makes an increase in frame rate
 Rework of map generation system. Rather than picking maps from lists of empty rooms and connecting them randomly, now makes maps from pre-determined chunks (e.g., upstairs and downstairs). This should allow layouts that feel more similar to a normal house (i.e., doesn't have 5 kitchens and 9 living rooms) with better looping so you won't be hitting dead ends so often
 Added new props to some rooms 
 When another player joins an online lobby, their bear outfit and fur now show in the Main Menu
 Added DualSense to controller options
 Added damage falloff to explosive damage
 Added unicorn skin


Fixes

 Fixed player character third person mesh t-posing whilst shooting
 Fixed issue with ‘Shark’ enemy applying attack animation to player whilst down in online can cause player to never revive 
 Fixed issue with ‘Be Quiet’ gameplay event countdown timer stays on screen for client players in online after event complete, until countdown reaches 0
 Fixed issue where lights would flicker on and off
 Fixed issue with Third Person Camera not rendering certain layers
 Fixed issue with Host Player not transiting to game over if Host Player Down and client player leaves 
 Fixed a bug where key rebinding wasn't working for controllers
 Fixed a bug where 2 level up points would get used when levelling up using a controller
 Fixed some UI bugs in the wardrobe that lead to the equipped and locked symbol showing at the same time
 Fixed issue where the Remap button wouldn't get selected when using a controller
 Fixed the bug where Steam would say the game was still playing
 Fixed the bug where the UI message would sometimes say "sprite index=999" instead of showing the correct sprite
 Fixed issue with equipped weapon UI changing to ‘Boom Corn’ image 
 Fixed the bug where the weapon/ammo pickup wouldn’t give the player the full amount of ammo if they had the increase Ammo perk
 Players now stop reviving another player if they’re too far away
 Fixed issue where music volume was incorrectly labelled volume
 Fixed no outline around umbrella rifle in online mode


Changes 

 Reduced local file size from 11gb to 5gb
 Changed the revive interaction to say Hold instead of Press
 Added bonus XP for headshots
 Player now gets more XP for shadow monster and shark kills
 Added a cooldown to the ping system
 Downed players now get shown the revive progress UI when another player is reviving them in online horde
 New Rig and Animations for enemies to Improve performance 
 Ping has been switched from F/Alt to the Mouse Scroll Wheel button
 Added ultimate steps to the tutorial
 Reduced size of ping UI 
 Changed new night generating screen


Known Issues

 Players sometimes briefly unable to move if at weapon pickup whilst another player is using level up station 
 Night 2 (Wave 11+) – Teleporter in start room sometimes unable to teleport player 
 Sometimes performance issues on Night 5 (Wave 40+)
 Music sometimes jitters in game after clicking Restart

notes.title: STUFFED Early Access Release Date
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce STUFFED will be released in early access on December 9th! 

We can't wait for you all to get a chance to play ːsteamhappyː

There is lots of new content planned throughout early access for STUFFED. We have created a Roadmap for you all to see some of the plans we have for the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37976502/e9c057aa52a50d566b7fa44f735698c8719c4b9f.png

As always, we want to hear your suggestions and feedback to help improve it.

The best way to do this will be to join the STUFFED discord where you can chat with the devs directly - https://discord.gg/CtTFVKMmax

See you all on December 9th!
